attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless Podman-based web app (nginx:alpine) on node1 (Alpine Linux, no systemd) running entirely as the unprivileged user appsvc, listening on host port 8080. Created appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges for rootless user-namespace containers, enabled the OpenRC cgroups service, ran the container as appsvc via su, and wrote a custom OpenRC init script (/etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp) that recreates the tmpfs XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and starts/stops the container as appsvc without any interactive login session, registered in the default runlevel. Verified boot persistence across two full node reboots: boot_id changed each time, the service auto-started, HTTP 200 was served on port 8080 from both loopback and NODE_IP, the nginx/conmon processes were owned by uid appsvc, and `who` showed no active login session for appsvc.
